parsed.self_critique_fixed: Applied the hook rule (T7) by starting the first line with the native word 'Mehangi' instead of 'Expensive' to ensure a native-language thumbstop. Maintained strict code-mixing (T1, T2) with words like 'coaching classes', 'fail', 'speaking practice', 'personalized plan', and 'mistakes' left in English as they are part of daily spoken Hindi. Used casual, natural peer register (T3, T4) with WhatsApp-style romanization (T10).
